heightPolicy.tag: Source height in metres; supplied height is not independently surveyed or verified.
heightPolicy.levels: Source num_floors multiplied by an estimated 3 metres per floor.
heightPolicy.default: Fixed 12 metre visualization height, not a measured or predicted building height.
heightPolicy.globfp2020: 2020 remote-sensing height prediction from 3D-GloBFP v3, accepted only after strict bidirectional footprint overlap; rounded to 0.1 m for display, not a surveyed height or accuracy claim.
